about_the_game:
Experience a vibrant Idle RPG with fully visual combat. Complete quests, craft gear, and manage resources. Master 10+ skills to create items you can equip or sell. Your journey never stops, even offline. No Microtransactions, No P2W—just pure fun.

Between Adventures IDLE is designed for those who love RPG progression but respect their time. Unlike text-based idle games, here you see every slash, spell, and loot drop in charming pixel art.

Craft your gear, manage your inventory, and optimize your build. Whether you are actively clicking or letting the game run in the background, your journey never stops.

  • ⚔️Strategic Visual Combat: Engage in battles against unique enemys and challenging bosses. Don't just read about it—watch your character fight in real-time. Utilize melee, ranged, and magic skills, supported by a deep buff and spell system to overcome your foes.

  • ⛏️Profession System: Master over 8+ different skills, including Mining, Gathering, Woodcutting, Fishing, Blacksmithing, Crafting, Cooking and Alchemy. Your non-combat skills are just as important as your sword.

  • 📜Extensive Skill Tree: Forge your own path. Use the Skill Tree to specialize your character, creating a build that suits your playstyle—whether you want to be a tanky warrior or a gathering expert.

  • 💰Crafting & Economy: Why buy when you can create? Craft your own items, hunt for better gear across a 5-Tier Item System, and manage your economy by trading with various vendors.

  • 🧭A World of Quests: Follow the Main Story Quest and experience an incredibly generic RPG story, or discover countless Side Quests, Combat & Idle Quests at your own pace.

  • 💎Easy to Start, Deep to Master: With a clean and simple interface, the game is easy to jump into but offers deep strategic layers. Whether you play actively or let the game progress in the background, your adventure never stops.

  • 👑A True Premium Experience: Respect for the player comes first. No microtransactions, no ads, and absolutely no pay-to-win. Buy once, play forever.

Between Adventures IDLE offers a fresh take on adventure, combining strategy, exploration, trade, and combat in a way that's both engaging and approachable. Whether you prefer quick sessions or longer journeys, there's always something new to discover, making every moment enjoyable in its own way.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 12.04, SteamOS (Proton-8 Recommended)
  • Processor: 1.7 GHz Processor
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce 8 or higher, ATI X1600 or higher, or Intel HD 3000 or higher
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: OpenAL Compatible Sound Card
  • Additional Notes: Proton-8 Recommended

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Mac OS X 10.6 or above
  • Processor: Apple Silicon M1 (M2 and M3) or Intel Core M
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 1280x720 minimum resolution, OpenGL 2.0 Support, and recommended dedicated graphics card with 128 MB of RAM
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: OpenAL Compatible Sound Card
  • Additional Notes: M1, M2, M3 Silicon Mac & ARM Supported
